3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an Fir lodged on 29.06.2022 alleging that
the applicant had enticed away the informant's daughter aged about 18 years on 25.06.2022.
4.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the aforesaid consistent stand of the victim that she is major and she has married the applicant out of her own free will, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Vikash Sharma be released on bail in Case Crime No. 0317 pf 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC & Section 3/4 Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012,
